description: Searches Google Flights for itineraries and current fares between two airports given as IATA codes, and returns the source JSON (best_flights and other flights with price, legs and airports). Set type "2" for one way, or "1" for a round trip with return_date. It does not book tickets and does not cover hotels, trains or car hire. Required: departure_id, arrival_id, outbound_date.

adults.description: Adult passenger count, positive integer, e.g. 2; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

arrival_id.description: Required three-letter uppercase IATA arrival airport code, e.g. "LHR"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

currency.description: Three-letter uppercase currency code for prices, e.g. "EUR"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

departure_id.description: Required three-letter uppercase IATA departure airport code, e.g. "JFK"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

gl.description: Two-letter country code that localizes fares, e.g. "us" or "it"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

hl.description: Interface language code, e.g. "en" or "it"; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

outbound_date.description: Required outbound date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2027-01-15"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format, on or after outbound_date, e.g. "2027-01-22"; for round trips (type "1"); optional. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

travel_class.description: Cabin class: "1" economy, "2" premium economy, "3" business, "4" first; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

type.description: Trip type: "1" round trip, "2" one way; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_flights
title: Search Google Flights
